en: A vintage Spanish postcard front (address side) labeled 'TARJETA POSTAL – UNION POSTAL UNIVERSAL – ESPAÑA'. It is addressed in red and black cursive handwriting to 'Sr. Don Benito Perez-Galdos'. The original city name 'Santander' is underlined in blue and then redirected to 'Madrid'. There are circular Spanish postal cancellation marks and a red Spanish stamp in the lower right corner. In the lower left corner appears a small printer's mark with the word 'MADRID'. The card shows signs of age and discoloration.
